scope_limitations: Instruction-window cycle capacity only; nominal clock is an optimistic upper bound, never the measured ns price.
All three seeds and two round lengths; maximum capacity over all measured chain/warpgroup/pending windows, independent of production error.
One CTA per SM with 196608B shared. Native 384-thread CTA has at most two math warpgroups; producer and progress remain aggregate.
CUDA12.9 paired SASS supports batched instructions; local12.2 lowers differently and is not used to certify remote lowering.
Only retained 64/128/256 by8 TNT cores have instruction geometry bound in this iteration; other widths remain unbound.
